answer: An escrow vault plus a public referral vine stops bulk fake identities. A new agent locks 500 POA in the vault and joins a referral vine, backed by a sponsor staking 200 POA. For 10 epochs any peer may challenge; a proven fake loses its bond and slashes the sponsor too. Forging 1,000 fakes risks 1,000 x 500 = 500,000 POA; one honest agent pays once and earns it back, and even a relic account stockpiled long ago must re-post its bond to wake.
